## Key ideas {#fv2-finish .fv-lesson .proof-lesson }

```{=html}
<div class="fv-equation"><span data-math="|\underset{\sim}{a}\cdot\underset{\sim}{b}|\leq|\underset{\sim}{a}||\underset{\sim}{b}|"></span></div><p>Equality: parallel non-zero vectors in either direction, or a zero vector.</p><div class="proof-key">Choose vectors → Translate the claim → Justify each step</div><p>I can translate a mathematical claim into vector notation and construct a justified proof.</p>
```

::: {.notes}
Ask for one example of how a geometric fact became a vector statement. Revisit the distinction between knowing a property and proving it from the supplied assumptions. If teaching over two periods, use this slide as a brief recap whenever helpful; do not impose a stopping point.
:::
